""" Web scraper for extracting API documentation from HTML pages. This initial implementation provides basic HTML parsing functionality that will be evolved to handle complex documentation structures. The LLM will have access to actual documentation pages through optillm's readurls plugin, allowing it to understand the specific HTML structure and improve the parsing logic accordingly. """ from bs4 import BeautifulSoup from typing import Dict, List, Optional import re # EVOLVE-BLOCK-START def scrape_api_docs(html_content: str) -> List[Dict[str, any]]: """ Extract API documentation from HTML content. Args: html_content: Raw HTML content of a documentation page Returns: List of dictionaries containing function documentation """ soup = BeautifulSoup(html_content, "html.parser") functions = [] seen_names = set() # Track unique function names # Try multiple approaches to find functions # 1. Look for dt elements with sig class (most structured - prioritize this) dt_blocks = soup.find_all("dt", class_="sig") for block in dt_blocks: sig_name = block.find(class_="sig-name") if sig_name: name = sig_name.get_text(strip=True) if name and name not in seen_names: seen_names.add(name) signature = block.get_text(strip=True) # Find description in next dd element description = "No description found" dd = block.find_next_sibling("dd") if dd: first_p = dd.find("p") description = first_p.get_text(strip=True)[:300] if first_p else dd.get_text(strip=True)[:300] functions.append({ "name": name, "signature": signature, "description": description, "parameters": extract_parameters(signature), }) # 2. Look for code blocks code_blocks = soup.find_all("code") for block in code_blocks: text = block.get_text(strip=True) if "(" in text and ")" in text and len(text) < 200: name = text.split("(")[0].strip() # Only add if name looks valid and not duplicate if name and name not in seen_names and name.replace("_", "").replace(".", "").isalnum(): seen_names.add(name) description = block.find_next("p").get_text(strip=True)[:300] if block.find_next("p") else "No description found" functions.append({ "name": name, "signature": text, "description": description, "parameters": extract_parameters(text), }) # 3. Look for function signatures in headers (h2, h3, h4) for tag in ["h3", "h2", "h4"]: headers = soup.find_all(tag) for block in headers: text = block.get_text(strip=True) if "(" in text and ")" in text: name = text.split("(")[0].strip() if name and name not in seen_names: seen_names.add(name) # Look for description in next sibling description = "No description found" next_elem = block.find_next_sibling(["p", "div"]) if next_elem: description = next_elem.get_text(strip=True)[:300] functions.append({ "name": name, "signature": text, "description": description, "parameters": extract_parameters(text), }) return functions[:35] # Return more functions for better completeness def extract_parameters(signature: str) -> List[Dict[str, str]]: """ Extract parameter information from a function signature. Args: signature: Function signature string Returns: List of parameter dictionaries """ params = [] # Extract parameters from signature match = re.search(r"\((.*?)\)", signature) if match: param_string = match.group(1) if param_string: param_parts = param_string.split(",") for part in param_parts: part = part.strip() if part and part not in ["self", "cls", "*", "**"]: # Extract name, type, and default value param_name = part.split("=")[0].split(":")[0].strip() # Remove * or ** prefix param_name = param_name.lstrip("*") param_type = "unknown" default_val = None # Extract type if present (name: type) if ":" in part: type_part = part.split(":")[1].split("=")[0].strip() param_type = type_part if type_part else "unknown" # Extract default if present (name=default or name: type = default) if "=" in part: default_val = part.split("=")[-1].strip() if param_name: # Only add if we have a valid name params.append({ "name": param_name, "type": param_type, "default": default_val, "description": "", }) return params def format_documentation(api_docs: List[Dict[str, any]]) -> str: """ Format extracted documentation into a readable string. Args: api_docs: List of API documentation dictionaries Returns: Formatted documentation string """ output = [] for doc in api_docs: output.append(f"Function: {doc['name']}") output.append(f"Signature: {doc['signature']}") output.append(f"Description: {doc['description']}") if doc.get("parameters"): output.append("Parameters:") output.extend([f" - {param['name']}: {param.get('description', 'No description')}" for param in doc["parameters"]]) output.append("") # Empty line between functions return "\n".join(output) # EVOLVE-BLOCK-END # Example usage and test if __name__ == "__main__": # Sample HTML for testing basic functionality sample_html = """
json.dumps(obj, indent=2)

Serialize obj to a JSON formatted string.

json.loads(s)

Deserialize s to a Python object.

""" docs = scrape_api_docs(sample_html) print(format_documentation(docs)) print(f"\nExtracted {len(docs)} functions")
